articles.raw_summary: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. articles.title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
articles.raw_summary: Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. articles.raw_summary: Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. articles.title: VETNET: Assembling Benchmark Datasets for AI-Driven Veterinary Innovation
articles.raw_summary: VETNET represents an ecosystem of live benchmark datasets and evaluation frameworks designed to accelerate AI-driven innovation in animal science and veterinary medicine through standardized, high-quality datasets and multi-institutional collaboration across academic and non-academic sectors. This framework addresses the gap between AI advances in human medicine and the fragmented state of veterinary AI development.

articles.title: Lotus: Learning to Understand Time-series by Learning to Forecast
articles.raw_summary: Time-series language models typically align numerical signals with language using labels, captions, or question-answer pairs. Although such supervision encourages linguistic representations, it does not explicitly require them to preserve information about how the underlying time-series signal evolves. articles.title: PMO-Dock: Benchmarking Docking, Specificity, and Generalization in Molecular Optimization
articles.raw_summary: The Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark standardized evaluation in molecular optimization, but it is built on simple property-based oracles that do not capture structure-based drug design.
